2609.09625.title: From State Synchronization to Cognitive Self-Evolution: An Operational Architecture for Cognitive Digital Twins
2609.09625.paper_summary: As Digital Twin (DT) systems evolve beyond state synchronization toward task-oriented and knowledge-driven operation, Cognitive Digital Twins (CDTs) have emerged as an extension that incorporates cognitive capabilities into twin operation. Existing CDT studies often focus on specific enabling techniques, such as learning modules, knowledge graphs, and large language models, while providing limited insight into how cognition can be systematically integrated into DT architectures. To address this issue, this paper proposes a four-layer CDT architecture consisting of the physical layer, digital-twin layer, cognitive layer, and task layer. The proposed architecture establishes a self-evolving closed operational loop spanning these four layers, in which physical states are synchronized into digital representations, cognition constructs task-specific cognitive models through knowledge, memory, and attention, and task-level decisions are generated under practical constraints. Operational feedback further refines cognitive experience and updates relationships and annotations in the digital representation, enabling subsequent task interpretation, initiation, and reasoning to evolve with system operation. Based on this framework, two representative operation modes are characterized: user-request-driven cognition and self-driven cognition. We further discuss key enabling mechanisms and deployment challenges associated with semantic communication, knowledge querying, task orchestration, and closed-loop synchronization. A lightweight simulation study illustrates reliable closed-loop task feasibility under limited semantic information and improved operational efficiency through accumulated task experience. The proposed framework provides a structured foundation for the design and development of future CDT systems.
2609.09625.paper_summary_zh: 隨著數位雙胞胎（DT）系統從狀態同步演變為以任務為導向和知識驅動的運作，認知數位雙胞胎（CDT）作為一種擴展，將認知能力納入雙胞胎操作中。現有的CDT研究通常專注於特定的啟用技術，例如學習模塊、知識圖譜和大型語言模型，同時對於如何將認知系統性地整合到DT架構中提供的見解有限。為了解決這個問題，本文提出了一個由物理層、數位雙胞胎層、認知層和任務層組成的四層CDT架構。所提出的架構建立了一個自我演變的閉環操作循環，跨越這四個層次，其中物理狀態被同步為數位表示，認知通過知識、記憶和注意力構建任務特定的認知模型，並在實際限制下生成任務級決策。操作反饋進一步精煉認知經驗，並更新數位表示中的關係和註釋，使後續的任務解釋、啟動和推理能夠隨著系統操作而演變。基於這一框架，特徵化了兩種代表性的操作模式：用戶請求驅動的認知和自我驅動的認知。我們進一步討論與語義通信、知識查詢、任務協調和閉環同步相關的關鍵啟用機制和部署挑戰。一項輕量級的模擬研究展示了在有限語義信息下可靠的閉環任務可行性，以及通過累積任務經驗提高操作效率。所提出的框架為未來CDT系統的設計和開發提供了結構化的基礎。
